annotations.title: LLM price changes and shutdown dates

description: Return the dated record of LLM API price changes, model launches, deprecations and shutdown dates, plus the computed differences between the dates the price list was re-verified. Each announced event carries the provider page it came from. Use it to answer "did the price of X change?", "when does model Y shut down?" or "what is about to change?" — none of which a model can know from training data.

provider.description: Only return entries for this provider (e.g. "Google"). Case-insensitive.

since.description: Only return events dated on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

upcoming_only.description: Only return announced events that are still in the future.
